defs.def: made or experienced recently 新近的；新近出现的；新近体验的

ex.s: “Part of being a good thinker is experiencing things that are seemingly unrelated to what you are working on at the moment but give you fresh ideas about your work,” he says.
ex.t: 成为一个好的思考者，部分在于体验那些看似与当前工作无关、却能给你工作带来新想法的事物，他说。

defs.def: new or different in a way that adds to or replaces sth 新的；不同的

ex.s: Then you can print out a fresh draft, again setting your text on triple-space.
ex.t: 然后你可以打印一份新草稿，再次将文本设为三倍行距。

ex.s: 40   You should reassess your goals, and motivate yourself to set a fresh goal.
ex.t: 40   你应该重新评估目标，并激励自己设定一个新目标。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我想我比其他人强一些，因为谢瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问道："艾迪，我在想你是否愿意在周六晚上的读书会上把整首诗背诵出来。"她说一位著名教授将要做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新颖的开场方式。
